flags.why: The folk belief concerns bringing misfortune to others, rather than being prone to misfortune oneself ([source](https://vanhoatamlinh.com/via-la-gi-trom-via-la-gi-via-nang-via-nhe-la-nhu-the-nao/)).
flags.fix: believed to bring bad luck to others (folk belief)

flags.why: Nệm xe denotes the seat cushioning, whereas its covering is bọc nệm xe ([source](https://tuantuauto.com/boc-nem-xe-hoi)).
The example defines endoplasm instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Các hạt nhỏ chuyển động trong nội chất. = Small particles move within the endoplasm.
